patches.decision_note: Complete-document coverage changes the artifact, while pass count, revision count, and final-draft timing describe project workflow rather than document behavior.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
The estimate you sent, $3100.00, works for me. Thank you.

A few follow-up items:

1) Would a 72-hour turnaround for the draft after I provide the final narrative, followed by a 72-hour turnaround on your end for final revisions, be workable? My subcontractors will not send their content until EOD next Friday, so your working window will be compressed.

2) I have shifted the branding from the client to the bidder—me—so please design it around my company's identity, Blue Mesa Strategies. I can provide the logo and colors.

3) This will be the first proposal I submit as a prime (I launched my company less than a year ago, and I’m solo), so I want it to serve as a reusable template and not have to rebuild future proposals from scratch. Please make the sections swappable and modular: a) a flexible narrative structure (for example, 12 sections vs. 18 sections), b) a modular table style that resizes for different budget structures, and c) a “prepared for ___ [client name]” credit line rather than client branding.

4) Canva: Will I still own the files if I do not have a paid subscription? Will source files exist in another format, or will everything be entirely in Canva?

Thank you!

patches.decision_note: Switching the design identity from Civic Canopy to Blue Mesa makes the prior requirement to source fonts from Civic Canopy obsolete.
The source establishes ownership without a paid Canva subscription as an acceptance condition but does not itself establish delivery by editable link or post-revision editing timing.
